production_decision.summary: The three probes identify research candidates, not validated executable alpha.

contract.exit: TP8 after a later strict minute-high cross, otherwise same-day close mark
contract.selection: fixed Top20; unavailable slots remain cash; no after-open replacement

hard_limitations: The test window and TP8/Top20 policy have already been inspected; this is not an untouched holdout.
About 72 percent of audited selections are in the 20 percent signal-day price-limit band.
The primary benchmark matches entry path, invested weight, and price-limit band, but not industry, size, volatility, liquidity, or momentum.
The 09:31 close entry, bar-high TP fill, and 83 close exits marked at down limit are execution upper bounds.
Capacity, queue position, market impact, and multi-day carry after an unexecutable exit are not simulated.

contract.signal_time: T close after complete minute data
contract.label: T+1 market open to T+2 market open
contract.calendar: explicit market-calendar lookup; no per-symbol suspension skipping
contract.walk_forward: 80 train dates, 1 purged date, 10 test dates

hard_limitations: The five volume features were selected on overlapping history, so this is not an untouched factor holdout.
The static Top200 universe is not point-in-time.
Blocked orders are audited but the target-fill return remains an execution upper bound.
Incremental net return is not statistically significant and recent short-window IC is unstable.
Missing future rows make full-universe active-return inference fail closed.

contract.refit_semantics: three approximately 84-evaluation-day research refits, not monthly production validation
contract.ic_semantics: conditional on finite future labels with explicit daily coverage
contract.top_bucket_semantics: freeze T-day Top4/Top20; any selected missing label makes the day unavailable

minute_lag0_vs_daily_only.decision: Minute lag0 features have repeatable conditional rank evidence and remain candidates for validation.

minute_lag1_vs_lag0.decision: There is no evidence that lag1 improves on lag0.

hermite_in_xgb_vs_lag0.decision: Do not add Hermite stability to XGB.

hermite_b_guard_off_minus_on.decision: The guard effect is not significant; retain the existing guard pending better execution and PIT data.

source_regimes.limitation: lag timing is confounded with provider regime; minute_active_ratio requires a fixed 241-bar denominator or removal

hard_limitations: All aggregate return means fail closed because future label/tradability gaps remain.
Conditional IC is rank evidence, not an execution backtest.
Blocked trades are audited without cash/carry position simulation.
Industry classification is current/static rather than point-in-time.
Provider regime changes confound lag attribution.
The evaluation axis is validated against trade_cal for this artifact, but the general feature builder still derives horizons from the daily frame.

known_data_gaps.effect: Nine mature Watch20 signal dates have zero future-label coverage; next-open fixed slots fail closed on affected entry dates.
known_data_gaps.disposition: Do not derive limits heuristically; backfill the authoritative limit-status source and rebuild daily clean in a separate data transaction.

research_workspace.governance: passed: registered candidate-research hotspots; tight baseline budgets
